title: Senior Product Engineer
description: You'll lead end-to-end product engineering on client builds. Own architecture, ship features in tight cycles, and mentor mid-level engineers. We're looking for 5+ years across web and mobile, and a track record of taking products from idea to production.

title: Product Designer
description: Translate founder vision into clear product systems. You'll own UX flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs for client products. Strong systems thinking, comfort with ambiguity, and a portfolio that shows iteration are required.

title: AI Engineer (contract)
description: Six-month engagement to embed AI workflows into client products. You'll integrate LLM APIs, design prompt strategies, and build evals. Comes with a path to full-time for the right person.
